newsitem.title: USA: Boeing says Senior V.P. Beighle to retire.
newsitem.headline: Boeing says Senior V.P. Beighle to retire.

text.p: The Boeing Co on Friday said Douglas Beighle, senior vice president and chief administrative officer, has decided to retire from the company on May 1.

Beighle, 64, was elected a senior vice president in April 1986 and currently has the responsibility for divisions such as Legal, Contracts, Corporate Secretary, Government Affairs, Public Relations and Community Affairs.
He also has served as a member of the company's Executive Council since 1980 and as chairman of the Corporate Contributions Committee.

Beighle joined Boeing in April 1980 as corporate vice president, Contracts. In September 1981 he was elected vice president and assumed the additional responsibilities of General Counsel and Secretary.
